title: DevIntel Insight
description: Contract 2. The single output format every intelligence component returns. The platform stores these in the Knowledge Repository (MongoDB 'insights' collection) and the dashboard renders them with shared widgets.

component.description: Which intelligence component produced this insight.

type.description: Machine-readable insight kind, chosen by the component, e.g. 'effort-estimate', 'sprint-health', 'quality-risk', 'reviewer-recommendation'.

title.description: One-line human-readable headline shown on the insight card.

target.description: The thing this insight is about.

prediction.description: The main output. 'value' may be a number, string, list or object.

confidence.description: Model confidence in [0, 1], or null if not applicable.

severity.description: How urgently a human should look at this.

explanation.description: Feature contributions (e.g. SHAP values, or weighted signals). Positive impact pushes the prediction up.

recommendations.description: Plain-language suggested actions. A human decides whether to act.

evidence.description: Links back to the source data that supports this insight.

modelVersion.description: Identifies the model/settings that produced this insight, e.g. 'rr-v1'.

isStub.description: True while the component returns placeholder output. The dashboard labels stub insights clearly.
